meta.title: Submitting an award while bidding is still open stops the bidding
gaps: The plan does not verify that the pricing round's ending time is expired because the available assertion operators require a numeric literal for lte and provide no supported dynamic comparison with {{now}}.

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer opens an award proposal.
The buyer awards the line to a vendor on the proposal.
The invited QA vendor places a complete bid (open, price, submit).
As the buyer, read the pricing round and check that the round counts no new bid (the refused bid left nothing).
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “Trade Request not found”, and never with a server error. Read back afterwards: the round counts no new bid (the refused bid left nothing).

plan.title: Submitting an award while bidding is still open stops the bidding

assert.say: the round counts no new bid (the refused bid left nothing)
